scope: Bounded import-time capture of decoded DXF entity source owner candidates, plus immutable sorted geometry snapshots for a selected live HATCH/polyline match.
controls: Distinct group-330 owner and nested reactor decode separately for locally authored HATCH and LWPOLYLINE.
Duplicate entity handles invalidate the owner lookup without mutating its output parameter.
At 65536 unique identities the next addition disables and clears the inventory; clear then permits retry.
Matching geometry produces a snapshot; failed matching leaves it unchanged and moving both objects changes it.
Deleted and modified source edges and a stale cached loop refuse matching.
limits: Decoded owners alone are not physical proof of exactly one source owner or reactor group.
Partial import, source space identity, provenance, graph closure and late-edit checks remain open.
This slice does not enable associative HATCH replay.
